task:tangential_quadrilateral_side_sum_v.object_description: It includes a convex quadrilateral whose four sides are tangent to an incircle, labeled vertices, tangency points, and two visible side-length labels.
task:tangential_quadrilateral_side_sum_v.annotation_hint: set "annotation" to a JSON object with exactly these keys: "vertex_A", "vertex_B", "vertex_C", "vertex_D", "tangent_AB", "tangent_BC", "tangent_CD", "tangent_DA", and "incircle_center"; each value must be the pixel point [x,y] at that visible vertex, tangency point, or circle center
task:tangential_quadrilateral_side_sum_v.answer_hint: set "answer" to the requested opposite-side sum as an integer

task:square_circle_tangent_angle_value_q.object_description: It includes a square or rectangle, a circle or semicircle, a tangent line, radius to T, one known angle, and one target angle marked ?.
task:square_circle_tangent_angle_value_q.annotation_hint: set "annotation" to a JSON object with exactly these keys: "shape_corner_A", "shape_corner_B", "shape_corner_C", "shape_corner_D", "circle_center", "tangent_point", "known_angle_vertex", "known_angle_reference_point", "target_angle_vertex", and "target_reference_point"; each value must be the pixel point [x,y] at the named corner, construction point, or angle point
task:square_circle_tangent_angle_value_q.answer_hint: set "answer" to the target angle in degrees as an integer
